sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯 DealBook 报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、

sentences.en: Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多嘉宾。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播部分采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is A Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, a Times investigation has uncovered unprecedented levels of violence and lawlessness inside New York City's main jail complex on Rikers Island.
sentences.zh: 今天，一项《时报》调查揭露了纽约市赖克斯岛主要监狱综合体内前所未有的暴力和无法无天现象。

sentences.en: Ested Hermden spoke with our colleague, Jan Ransom, about one man's recent experience there and why Rikers guards have, in effect, handed over control of the jail to its detainees.
sentences.zh: 埃斯特德·赫姆登与我们的同事简·兰瑟姆谈论了一名男子最近在那里的经历，以及为什么赖克斯岛的狱警实际上已经将监狱的控制权移交给了囚犯。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, October 14th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月14日，星期四。

sentences.en: Jan, can you tell us about the reporting that you've been doing on Rikers Island?
sentences.zh: 简，你能跟我们讲讲你在赖克斯岛所做的报道吗？

sentences.en: Sure, Ested.
sentences.zh: 当然，埃斯特德。

sentences.en: So I've been covering Rikers since I joined the Times in 2017.
sentences.zh: 我从2017年加入《时报》起就开始报道赖克斯岛了。

sentences.en: It's one of the largest jail facilities in the country.
sentences.zh: 它是全国最大的监狱设施之一。

sentences.en: It sits between the Bronx and Queens on the East River in New York City.
sentences.zh: 它位于纽约市东河，介于布朗克斯区和皇后区之间。

sentences.en: And there are over 4,800 people there, a majority of which are awaiting trial.
sentences.zh: 那里关押着超过4800人，其中大多数人正在等待审判。

sentences.en: And so these are people who have not been convicted of a crime.
sentences.zh: 所以这些人还没有被判有罪。

sentences.en: And the rest of the population includes people who are there on technical parole violations.
sentences.zh: 其余的人口包括因违反假释技术规定而被关押的人。

sentences.en: In the four years that I've been covering Rikers, I've written about a number of abuses there, whether
sentences.zh: 在我报道赖克斯岛的四年里，我写过许多关于那里的虐待事件，无论是

sentences.en: it was guards who were accused of assaulting detainees, to jail staff who have neglected to provide care to
sentences.zh: 狱警被指控殴打囚犯，还是监狱工作人员疏于照顾

sentences.en: the mentally ill, to incarcerated people who have just been held in solitary confinement for weeks, if not months.
sentences.zh: 精神病患者，亦或是被关押者被单独监禁数周甚至数月。

sentences.en: Rikers has long been this place that lawmakers have described as a stain on the city.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，赖克斯岛一直被立法者描述为这座城市的污点。

sentences.en: But what we've seen in recent years is this effort to try to change the place, to reform it.
sentences.zh: 但近年来，我们看到人们试图改变这个地方，试图对其进行改革。

sentences.en: And there's even been this push to close down Rikers.
sentences.zh: 甚至还有关闭赖克斯岛的呼声。

sentences.en: But in spite of that, Rikers has just continued to have this reputation for violence and brutality.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，赖克斯岛依然保持着暴力和残酷的恶名。

sentences.en: It's just never been a place where good things happen.
sentences.zh: 它从来都不是一个会发生好事的地方。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's one of the country's most notorious jails, and certainly the city's most notorious one.
sentences.zh: 它是全国最臭名昭著的监狱之一，当然也是本市最臭名昭著的。

sentences.en: But what's happening right now at Rikers?
sentences.zh: 但赖克斯岛现在发生了什么？

sentences.en: What makes this moment unique?
sentences.zh: 是什么让这个时刻变得如此特殊？

sentences.en: Right now, we're seeing a complete collapse of the jail system, unlike we've seen in years, years, possibly decades.
sentences.zh: 此刻，我们目睹了监狱系统的彻底崩溃，这是多年、甚至几十年未见的。

sentences.en: And in recent months, I've been hearing a lot from people on the inside who have just been desperate for help.
sentences.zh: 近几个月来，我从内部人士那里听到了很多消息，他们迫切需要帮助。

sentences.en: Hey, Richard, how are you?
sentences.zh: 嘿，理查德，你好吗？

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 还好。

sentences.en: One of them is a man named Richard Brown.
sentences.zh: 其中一位是名叫理查德·布朗的男子。

sentences.en: Well, I wanted to see if you were still interested in chatting.
sentences.zh: 我想看看你是否还有兴趣聊天。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And who is Richard?
sentences.zh: 理查德是谁？

sentences.en: And Richard, tell me your age.
sentences.zh: 理查德，告诉我你的年龄。

sentences.en: I don't think I got that early on in the conversation.
sentences.zh: 对话刚开始时我好像没问到。
我49岁。

sentences.en: So Richard is 49.
sentences.zh: 所以理查德49岁。

sentences.en: He's from Connecticut, and he details cars for a living.
sentences.zh: 他来自康涅狄格州，以汽车美容为生。

sentences.en: And he was picked up in September on a probation violation for a domestic violence charge.
sentences.zh: 他因家暴指控违反假释规定，于9月被捕。

sentences.en: And so we never, ever spend any time at Rikers.
sentences.zh: 我们从来没在赖克斯岛待过。

sentences.en: No, never in my way.
sentences.zh: 不，从来没有。

sentences.en: I just read books and seen movies.
sentences.zh: 我只是读过书，看过电影。

sentences.en: He'd never been to Rikers before.
sentences.zh: 他以前从未去过赖克斯岛。

sentences.en: And when he gets there, the first place he's taken to is what's known as intake.
sentences.zh: 当他到达那里时，被带到的第一个地方就是所谓的“收容区”。

sentences.en: And what is intake?
sentences.zh: 什么是收容区？

sentences.en: What happens there?
sentences.zh: 那里发生了什么？

sentences.en: So intake is a place where people who are fresh off the street are housed.
sentences.zh: 收容区是刚从街上抓来的人被安置的地方。

sentences.en: It's a holding pen where people are supposed to be there no more than 24 hours.
sentences.zh: 那是一个临时关押处，人们在那里停留的时间不应超过24小时。

sentences.en: It's also where they are assessed by medical and mental health professionals.
sentences.zh: 这也是医疗和心理健康专业人员进行评估的地方。

sentences.en: But when Richard entered this intake cell, what he saw was very chaotic.
sentences.zh: 但当理查德进入这个收容牢房时，他看到的情况非常混乱。

sentences.en: What did he see?
sentences.zh: 他看到了什么？

sentences.en: So when Richard comes into intake, he sees crowded holding pens.
sentences.zh: 当理查德进入收容区时，他看到的是拥挤的临时牢房。

sentences.en: He sees no beds.
sentences.zh: 他看到没有床。

sentences.en: Some people are even sleeping standing up.
sentences.zh: 有些人甚至站着睡觉。

sentences.en: What about using the bathroom?
sentences.zh: 上厕所怎么办？

sentences.en: Yeah, one little bathroom.
sentences.zh: 是的，只有一个小厕所。

sentences.en: He sees one toilet, urine on the floor, and feces.
sentences.zh: 他看到一个马桶，地板上有尿液和粪便。

sentences.en: Like the older people would be scared to use the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 就像年纪大的人会害怕使用厕所一样。

sentences.en: He sees that, you know, people are scared to even use the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 他看到，你知道，人们甚至害怕使用厕所。

sentences.en: And why are they scared?
sentences.zh: 他们为什么害怕？

sentences.en: So within these holding pens, you have gang members who are essentially controlling everything that happens there.
sentences.zh: 在这些临时牢房里，有帮派成员基本上控制着那里发生的一切。

sentences.en: And so Richard described that, you know, some of the older detainees who were there were terrified about having to walk through people to get to the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 理查德描述说，一些年纪较大的被拘留者非常害怕必须穿过人群去上厕所。

sentences.en: And so instead, some of them, he said, just urinated and defecated on themselves.
sentences.zh: 所以他说，有些人干脆就尿在或拉在自己身上了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Any time that food arrived,
sentences.zh: 每次食物送来时，

sentences.en: the detainees who were gang members would get first dibs.
sentences.zh: 身为帮派成员的被拘留者会先挑。

sentences.en: And everyone else would get what was left or nothing at all.
sentences.zh: 其他人只能得到剩下的，或者什么都没有。

sentences.en: And after the gang ate, what was left for you?
sentences.zh: 帮派吃完后，给你剩下什么？

sentences.en: A cereal and a milk sometimes, just plain cereal.
sentences.zh: 有时是一点麦片和牛奶，有时只是纯麦片。

sentences.en: So while Richard is in intake, within two hours of him being there, he is assaulted by a group of gang members who wanted his sneakers.
sentences.zh: 所以当理查德在收容区时，他进去不到两个小时，就被一群想要他运动鞋的帮派成员袭击了。

sentences.en: See, it wasn't just one.
sentences.zh: 你看，不止一个人。

sentences.en: It's like four or five of them.
sentences.zh: 大概有四五个吧。

sentences.en: Oh, four or five of them assaulted you?
sentences.zh: 哦，四五个人袭击了你？

sentences.en: Luckily, he wasn't badly hurt, but it did leave him with some bruises.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，他没有受重伤，但身上留下了一些淤青。

sentences.en: How did you feel in that moment?
sentences.zh: 那一刻你感觉如何？

sentences.en: You know, you just got there.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你刚到那里。

sentences.en: You already got in a fight.
sentences.zh: 就卷入了一场斗殴。

sentences.en: How did you feel?
sentences.zh: 你感觉如何？

sentences.en: Scary.
sentences.zh: 很可怕。

sentences.en: I don't know what I was going to happen.
sentences.zh: 我不知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: I mean, scary.
sentences.zh: 我是说，很可怕。

sentences.en: He also saw gang members who were running this holding pen, pressuring people to strip.
sentences.zh: 他还看到管理这个临时牢房的帮派成员强迫人们脱衣服。

sentences.en: They made them strip.
sentences.zh: 他们强迫他们脱掉衣服。

sentences.en: They made them fight each other.
sentences.zh: 他们强迫他们互相打架。

sentences.en: And if they didn't strip.
sentences.zh: 如果他们不脱衣服。

sentences.en: They didn't fight each other.
sentences.zh: 他们不互相打架。

sentences.en: They didn't want to stab them.
sentences.zh: 他们不想捅他们。

sentences.en: The gang members threatened to stab them.
sentences.zh: 帮派成员威胁要捅他们。

sentences.en: It sounds like the gangs were running the place.
sentences.zh: 听起来像是帮派在管理那个地方。

sentences.en: They were.
sentences.zh: 确实是。

sentences.en: Where are the guards here?
sentences.zh: 狱警在哪里？

sentences.en: Why is there not supervision to stop this kind of lawlessness?
sentences.zh: 为什么没有监管来制止这种无法无天的行为？

sentences.en: Richard said there were two to three guards outside of the holding pens.
sentences.zh: 理查德说临时牢房外有两到三名狱警。

sentences.en: You know, he said they often did not intervene and would say things to the effect of what are they supposed to do?
sentences.zh: 他说他们通常不干预，只会说些诸如“他们能怎么办？”之类的话。

sentences.en: Or would say nothing at all.
sentences.zh: 或者干脆什么都不说。

sentences.en: He told me that at one point, some of the gang members were bullying another person.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，有一次，一些帮派成员在欺负另一个人。

sentences.en: It was the inmates telling them to hang themselves.
sentences.zh: 是囚犯们叫他去上吊。

sentences.en: By encouraging him to hang himself.
sentences.zh: 怂恿他去上吊。

sentences.en: And the guards were slow to respond.
sentences.zh: 而狱警反应迟缓。

sentences.en: They just sit here.
sentences.zh: 他们只是坐在那里。

sentences.en: I think they think they playing or I don't know what it is.
sentences.zh: 我想他们以为他们在玩闹，或者我不知道那是什么情况。

sentences.en: He also recalled seeing a detainee take a light from a fixture and smash it onto a guard's head through this opening slot.
sentences.zh: 他还记得看到一名被拘留者拆下灯具，通过开口处砸向一名狱警的头。

sentences.en: In response, the correctional officers sprayed the entire cell with pepper spray.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，惩教人员向整个牢房喷洒了胡椒喷雾。

sentences.en: They just sprayed the whole pen.
sentences.zh: 他们直接喷了整个牢房。

sentences.en: They sprayed almost every pen he was in.
sentences.zh: 他待过的几乎每个牢房都被喷过。

sentences.en: They sprayed it with lace.
sentences.zh: 他们喷了催泪剂。

sentences.en: And it just became this really chaotic scene.
sentences.zh: 场面变得非常混乱。

sentences.en: One of the guys caught a seizure.
sentences.zh: 其中一个人癫痫发作了。

sentences.en: Richard saw a man have a seizure.
sentences.zh: 理查德看到一个人癫痫发作。

sentences.en: They pulled him out and just left him on the side.
sentences.zh: 他们把他拉出来，就扔在一边。

sentences.en: And the guards pulled the man out of the cell and just left him in front of the cell there.
sentences.zh: 狱警把那个人从牢房里拉出来，就扔在牢房门前。

sentences.en: Did not, you know, call for medical assistance or render any aid.
sentences.zh: 没有呼叫医疗援助，也没有提供任何帮助。

sentences.en: You said they left him on the side of the gate.
sentences.zh: 你说他们把他留在大门边上。

sentences.en: Do you know how long they left him there?
sentences.zh: 你知道他们把他留在那儿多久吗？

sentences.en: They just left him there until they came to.
sentences.zh: 他们就让他待在那儿，直到他自己醒过来。

sentences.en: On top of all of this, Richard is asthmatic.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，理查德还患有哮喘。

sentences.en: And while this is happening, he actually has an asthma attack.
sentences.zh: 就在这一切发生时，他哮喘发作了。

sentences.en: And despite having asked a jail staffer for an inhaler, he didn't get one.
sentences.zh: 尽管他向监狱工作人员要了吸入器，但他没拿到。

sentences.en: How did you manage?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么撑过来的？

sentences.en: Then I had to put a wet thing around my nose so I could breathe.
sentences.zh: 我只好把湿东西围在鼻子上才能呼吸。

sentences.en: Instead, he tries to find a way to protect himself by using his T-shirt, wetting it, and wrapping it around his face.
sentences.zh: 相反，他试图通过弄湿T恤并围在脸上来保护自己。

sentences.en: Jen, how long did Richard have to spend in intake?
sentences.zh: 简，理查德在收容区待了多久？

sentences.en: How long in total?
sentences.zh: 总共待了多久？

sentences.en: Richard was in intake for a week.
sentences.zh: 理查德在收容区待了一周。

sentences.en: And remember, this is a place you're not supposed to be held in for more than 24 hours.
sentences.zh: 记住，这个地方本来不应该待超过24小时。

sentences.en: And he's eventually housed in a unit.
sentences.zh: 他最终被安置在一个单元里。

sentences.en: And despite everything that he just witnessed in intake, what he sees when he walks into this unit still manages to shock him.
sentences.zh: 尽管他在收容区目睹了一切，但当他走进这个单元时，所见所闻仍然让他感到震惊。

sentences.en: That's because there's no guard in the block at all.
sentences.zh: 那是因为监区里根本没有狱警。

sentences.en: He's placed into a unit that has no guards.
sentences.zh: 他被安置在一个没有狱警的单元里。

sentences.en: One guy, he just kept fighting the guy every time we went.
sentences.zh: 有一个家伙，每次我们过去，他都在打那个人。

sentences.en: He was just sitting there, and the guy just turned around and started beating him again.
sentences.zh: 他只是坐在那儿，那家伙就转过身又开始打他。

sentences.en: He just yelling, what did I ever do to you?
sentences.zh: 他只是大喊，我到底对你做了什么？

sentences.en: Why do you keep shooting?
sentences.zh: 你为什么一直打我？

sentences.en: Why do you keep shooting?
sentences.zh: 你为什么一直打我？

sentences.en: He recalled seeing a man constantly beaten by gang members and crying out, but there were no officers on the floor to help him.
sentences.zh: 他回忆说看到一个人不断被帮派成员殴打并大声呼救，但现场没有警官来帮他。

sentences.en: Every other day someone was getting beat up?
sentences.zh: 每隔一天就有人被打？

sentences.en: Every day somebody, not every other day, every day somebody got beat up.
sentences.zh: 每天都有人，不是每隔一天，是每天都有人被打。

sentences.en: He is seeing multiple fights a day.
sentences.zh: 他每天都能看到多起斗殴。

sentences.en: At least three or four times a day.
sentences.zh: 每天至少三四次。

sentences.en: And every minute that he was in there, he was just worried that something might happen to him.
sentences.zh: 他在那里的每一分钟，都担心自己会出事。

sentences.en: You know, Jen, for all the stories that I have heard and read about jails, this is still completely shocking.
sentences.zh: 你知道吗，简，尽管我听过也读过不少关于监狱的故事，但这依然让我感到无比震惊。

sentences.en: Are you hearing the same type of stories in the rest of your reporting that you heard from Richard?
sentences.zh: 你在后续报道中听到的故事，是否也和理查德所说的一样？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全一样。

sentences.en: I mean, I've been hearing from detainees and correction officers alike and reviewed court filings and city records.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我一直在听取被拘留者和惩教人员的讲述，也查阅了法庭文件和市政记录。

sentences.en: And Richard's story is a reflection of many stories just describing just bizarre, unimaginable scenes.
sentences.zh: 理查德的经历只是众多故事中的一个缩影，这些故事描述的场景简直荒诞离奇，令人难以想象。

sentences.en: Just recently, there was an incident in which a detainee took a bus and rammed it into the side of a building on Rikers.
sentences.zh: 就在最近，发生了一起被拘留者劫持公交车并撞向赖克斯岛监狱大楼侧面的事件。

sentences.en: And he did this easily because he had been left there without any supervision.
sentences.zh: 他之所以能轻易得手，是因为当时那里根本没有任何监管。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: In another instance, there was a detainee who stole keys from a correction officer and used those keys to let out one of his friends.
sentences.zh: 还有一起案例，一名被拘留者从惩教人员那里偷走了钥匙，并用这些钥匙放走了他的一个朋友。

sentences.en: And the chaos has just continued there, unabated.
sentences.zh: 那里的混乱状况一直持续着，丝毫没有减弱。

sentences.en: And the correction officers at Rikers have essentially given up their power and left it to the detainees.
sentences.zh: 赖克斯岛的惩教人员基本上已经放弃了权力，将其交给了被拘留者。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《时报》一个月，而且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序，首月即可免费使用。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Jan, you mentioned that correctional officers at Rikers have essentially given up their power and handed the jail over to the detainees.
sentences.zh: 简，你提到赖克斯岛的惩教人员基本上放弃了权力，把监狱交给了被拘留者。

sentences.en: How did that come to be?
sentences.zh: 这是怎么造成的？

sentences.en: Well, what's important to understand is that for all the longstanding issues Rikers has had over the years,
sentences.zh: 嗯，有一点很重要，那就是尽管赖克斯岛多年来一直存在各种长期问题，

sentences.en: it's also been a place where there's been little to no accountability for officers and their supervisors who don't follow the rules.
sentences.zh: 但它同时也是一个对不遵守规则的警员及其主管几乎没有任何问责机制的地方。

sentences.en: So part of why Rikers has always had such a notorious reputation isn't just because of the abuses that take place there, but also because they've often been left unchecked.
sentences.zh: 所以，赖克斯岛之所以名声狼藉，不仅是因为那里发生的虐待事件，还因为这些行为往往无人过问。

sentences.en: But what's very different about this current crisis is that we're not just seeing issues with how correctional officers behave while they're on the job,
sentences.zh: 但这次危机与以往非常不同的是，我们看到的不仅仅是惩教人员在职期间的行为问题，

sentences.en: but that a lot of officers just are not showing up to work.
sentences.zh: 而是许多警员根本就不来上班了。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: Right now, we're seeing a large number of officers who are either out sick or AWOL, currently about 1,600 officers.
sentences.zh: 目前，我们看到有大量警员请病假或擅离职守，大约有1600人。

sentences.en: So almost like a quarter of the 8,000 officers working in New York City jails.
sentences.zh: 这几乎占了纽约市监狱系统8000名警员的四分之一。

sentences.en: And when we talk about correctional officers, they are the people who keep jails running, right?
sentences.zh: 当我们谈论惩教人员时，他们是维持监狱运转的人，对吧？

sentences.en: They're needed for everything from taking a detainee down to the medical clinic or to an appointment with a mental health counselor or to court.
sentences.zh: 从带被拘留者去医疗诊所，到预约心理健康咨询师，再到出庭，一切都需要他们。

sentences.en: And so without them, we're seeing what we see now, which is a near total collapse of the very basic functions of a jail system.
sentences.zh: 所以没有他们，我们就会看到现在的情况，即监狱系统的基本功能几乎完全瘫痪。

sentences.en: Are correctional officers not essential workers?
sentences.zh: 惩教人员不是必要岗位工作人员吗？

sentences.en: How is it that they've just stopped coming to work in a pandemic?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们在疫情期间就不来上班了？

sentences.en: So you're totally right.
sentences.zh: 你说得完全正确。

sentences.en: They are essential workers and by law, they cannot strike.
sentences.zh: 他们确实是必要岗位工作人员，而且法律规定他们不得罢工。

sentences.en: But with the pandemic, you had officers get sick, hundreds of them.
sentences.zh: 但在疫情期间，有数百名警员感染了病毒。

sentences.en: You had some of them die.
sentences.zh: 其中一些人甚至因此丧生。

sentences.en: And a lot of these correctional officers are predominantly women and people of color who were the first to complain that they were not getting protective equipment when the pandemic hit.
sentences.zh: 许多惩教人员主要是女性和有色人种，他们是最早抱怨疫情爆发时没有获得防护装备的人。

sentences.en: And so a lot of them felt alone and unsupported by the administration, by their immediate bosses.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们中的许多人感到孤立无援，没有得到管理层和直属上司的支持。

sentences.en: And there was just this real resentment.
sentences.zh: 心中积压了真正的怨气。

sentences.en: And, you know, now you're seeing that some officers are simply just not showing up, that they are abusing a very generous sick leave policy,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，现在你看到一些警员干脆就不来上班了，他们在滥用一项非常慷慨的病假政策，

sentences.en: which essentially gives them unlimited time so long as they can have a doctor's note.
sentences.zh: 只要有医生证明，他们基本上可以无限期休假。

sentences.en: What does this mean then for the officers who are coming in, the rest of them?
sentences.zh: 那么，这对那些还在坚持上班的警员意味着什么呢？

sentences.en: So I've spoken to a number of correctional officers at Rikers.
sentences.zh: 我采访过赖克斯岛的一些惩教人员。

sentences.en: None of them were willing to be recorded because they're not allowed to speak to the media.
sentences.zh: 他们都不愿被录音，因为他们不允许接受媒体采访。

sentences.en: But what they've said is that they basically feel like they're working in an impossible situation.
sentences.zh: 但他们说，他们基本上觉得自己在一种不可能的处境下工作。

sentences.en: You know, officers in these situations are having to work triple shifts, which is 24 hours.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在这种情况下，警员们不得不连续工作三班，也就是24小时。

sentences.en: So a lot of these same conditions that Richard Brown described, they're working in those conditions without breaks, without food, without water.
sentences.zh: 所以，理查德·布朗描述的许多相同条件，他们就在那种没有休息、没有食物、没有水的环境下工作。

sentences.en: The infrastructure at Rikers is also crumbling.
sentences.zh: 赖克斯岛的基础设施也在不断崩塌。

sentences.en: And so you have detainees who are able to make weapons out of, say, plexiglass or scraps of metal that they're finding falling from the building.
sentences.zh: 所以，被拘留者能够用有机玻璃或从大楼上掉下来的金属碎片制作武器。

sentences.en: And so with some officers, they have made a conscious decision not to, for example, pursue a detainee who has a weapon.
sentences.zh: 因此，一些警员有意识地决定，例如，不去追捕持有武器的被拘留者。

sentences.en: You know, these would be officers who are alone, oftentimes having to use force against a detainee in a housing unit that has dozens of detainees.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这些警员往往是孤身一人，却不得不在一个有几十名被拘留者的监区内对被拘留者使用武力。

sentences.en: And also it may require for them to call for backup.
sentences.zh: 而且这可能还需要他们呼叫支援。

sentences.en: But in this moment, there are so many different emergencies happening in the jail system today at any given time, often backup is slow to respond.
sentences.zh: 但在当下，监狱系统随时都在发生各种紧急情况，支援往往响应缓慢。

sentences.en: So, for example, there was this one incident this past August where a detainee escaped and attacked a guard.
sentences.zh: 例如，去年八月发生了一起被拘留者逃跑并袭击警卫的事件。

sentences.en: And the only way for the guard to protect himself was to lock himself in the detainee's cell.
sentences.zh: 而警卫保护自己的唯一方法就是把自己锁在被拘留者的牢房里。

sentences.en: — You're saying that the corrections officer actually shut himself in a cell meant for a detainee in order to escape.
sentences.zh: 你是说惩教人员为了逃生，竟然把自己关进了本该关押被拘留者的牢房里。

sentences.en: — Right, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，正是这样。

sentences.en: And so what we're seeing is that it's an overall dangerous situation, not just for the people who are held on Rikers, but also for the people who work there.
sentences.zh: 所以我们看到的是，这不仅对关押在赖克斯岛的人来说是一个危险的处境，对在那里工作的人来说也是如此。

sentences.en: — So from what you're describing, these officers have been in extremely difficult situations.
sentences.zh: 那么根据你的描述，这些警员一直处于极其困难的境地。

sentences.en: And in some cases, they're actually avoiding intervening for their own safety.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，他们为了自身安全实际上在避免干预。

sentences.en: But what I am wondering is about what they've said about those times when their decision to not intervene has actually jeopardized the safety of the detainees.
sentences.zh: 但我感到好奇的是，他们对于那些因决定不干预而危及被拘留者安全的情况是怎么说的？

sentences.en: — Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I think it's important to make a distinction there that there's a difference between the officers who are trying to protect themselves
sentences.zh: 我认为有必要做出区分，那些试图保护自己、

sentences.en: and trying to think smartly about the new work environment that they're in right now versus officers who are being completely neglectful of their duties.
sentences.zh: 试图理智思考当前新工作环境的警员，与那些完全玩忽职守的警员之间是有区别的。

sentences.en: In fact, an officer I spoke to said that he's reported officers who he's witnessed behave badly, whether it's using too much force or otherwise not doing their job.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我采访的一位警员说，他曾举报过他亲眼目睹行为不端的同事，无论是过度使用武力还是其他不履行职责的行为。

sentences.en: It's not something that the officers who do show up every day in these conditions and who care about their job, it's not something that they support or condone.
sentences.zh: 对于那些每天在这些条件下坚持工作并关心自己职责的警员来说，他们并不支持或纵容这种行为。

sentences.en: — Jan, is what we're seeing at Rikers unique to Rikers?
sentences.zh: 简，我们在赖克斯岛看到的情况是那里独有的吗？

sentences.en: How much do we know about whether what's going on there is analogous to other jails across the country?
sentences.zh: 我们对那里发生的事情是否类似于全国其他监狱了解多少？

sentences.en: — So, yes, of course.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然。

sentences.en: It's true that the pandemic has affected jails all over the country.
sentences.zh: 疫情确实影响了全国各地的监狱，这是事实。

sentences.en: There are other facilities that have also had staffing shortages, and they have moved detainees out and are moving to shut down their facilities as a result.
sentences.zh: 其他设施也出现了人手短缺，他们因此转移了被拘留者并准备关闭设施。

sentences.en: But what I can say is that the result of the shortage at Rikers has created a crisis there that is particularly severe.
sentences.zh: 但我可以说，赖克斯岛的人手短缺所导致的危机尤为严重。

sentences.en: — It's been the deadliest year since 2015 and one of the most violent.
sentences.zh: 这是自2015年以来死亡人数最多的一年，也是最暴力的一年。

sentences.en: There have been 12 deaths in New York City jails, the vast majority at Rikers, including five people who committed suicide.
sentences.zh: 纽约市监狱系统发生了12起死亡事件，绝大多数发生在赖克斯岛，其中包括五起自杀事件。

sentences.en: — Wow.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: — There is this broad consensus that what we're seeing play out in Rikers right now is very different from what we've seen happening elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 人们普遍认为，我们现在在赖克斯岛看到的情况与我们在其他地方看到的情况截然不同。

sentences.en: — I gotta say, though, how surprising is all of this?
sentences.zh: 但我不得不说，这一切有多令人惊讶呢？

sentences.en: — I remember reading stories, many of which were written by you, at the start of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 我记得在疫情初期读过很多报道，其中许多还是你写的。

sentences.en: And I remember seeing activists and others sounding the alarm about how vulnerable Rikers was.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时看到活动人士和其他人发出警告，称赖克斯岛是多么脆弱。

sentences.en: Wasn't there warning signs before we reached this point?
sentences.zh: 难道在我们走到这一步之前就没有预警信号吗？

sentences.en: — Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对有。

sentences.en: For all the problems that the pandemic has caused, particularly in terms of this staffing shortage,
sentences.zh: 尽管疫情造成了各种问题，特别是在人手短缺方面，

sentences.en: this crisis is ultimately something that has been years, if not decades, in the making.
sentences.zh: 但这场危机归根结底是多年，甚至几十年来积累的结果。

sentences.en: Detainees and their advocates and people who work inside Rikers have been long calling for attention to how dysfunctional it is there,
sentences.zh: 被拘留者、他们的倡导者以及在赖克斯岛工作的人员长期以来一直呼吁关注那里的功能失调，

sentences.en: from the crumbling buildings to the lack of accountability for correction officers.
sentences.zh: 从摇摇欲坠的建筑到对惩教人员缺乏问责机制，无一例外。

sentences.en: — And when Mayor de Blasio was running for re-election in 2017, he vowed to shut Rikers down.
sentences.zh: 当白思豪市长在2017年竞选连任时，他曾誓言要关闭赖克斯岛。

sentences.en: But based on current plans, that won't happen until at least 2027.
sentences.zh: 但根据目前的计划，至少要到2027年才能实现。

sentences.en: So what we see instead are criticisms that, because officials in New York were so preoccupied with shutting Rikers down,
sentences.zh: 所以我们看到的批评是，由于纽约官员过于专注于关闭赖克斯岛，

sentences.en: there wasn't a whole lot of attention paid to improving the jail for however many years it will be in operation.
sentences.zh: 在它还能运营的这些年里，并没有投入太多精力去改善监狱状况。

sentences.en: — And so what is Mayor de Blasio and the city doing now to address these concerns?
sentences.zh: 那么白思豪市长和市政府现在正在采取什么措施来解决这些担忧？

sentences.en: — Everyone good?
sentences.zh: 大家都准备好了吗？

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: The mission for me today is to come and see the specific—
sentences.zh: 我今天的任务是来看看具体的——

sentences.en: — So it was just a few weeks ago that Mayor de Blasio visited Rikers for the first time in four years.
sentences.zh: 就在几周前，白思豪市长四年来首次访问了赖克斯岛。

sentences.en: — Look, we've got a hell of a lot of work to do.
sentences.zh: 听着，我们还有大量的工作要做。

sentences.en: I want to be very clear about that.
sentences.zh: 我想明确这一点。

sentences.en: — He didn't speak to any correction officers or detainees.
sentences.zh: 他没有与任何惩教人员或被拘留者交谈。

sentences.en: The intake cells had been cleaned up before he arrived.
sentences.zh: 在他到达之前，收押牢房已经被清理过了。

sentences.en: But he did acknowledge that things needed to be fixed.
sentences.zh: 但他确实承认事情需要得到解决。

sentences.en: — Please.
sentences.zh: 拜托。

sentences.en: — Guys, I'm trying to explain to you, the whole thing upsets me.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，我正试图向你们解释，整件事让我感到难过。

sentences.en: I'm not going to bring it down to one thing.
sentences.zh: 我不会把它归结为单一原因。

sentences.en: The whole situation must be profoundly changed.
sentences.zh: 整个局面必须彻底改变。

sentences.en: Last one, Gloria.
sentences.zh: 最后一个问题，格洛丽亚。

sentences.en: Go ahead.
sentences.zh: 请讲。

sentences.en: — And so he's put forward an emergency relief plan to address the crisis on the island.
sentences.zh: 所以他提出了一项紧急救援计划来应对岛上的危机。

sentences.en: He has instituted a new policy to crack down on absentee correction officers.
sentences.zh: 他制定了一项新政策，以打击缺勤的惩教人员。

sentences.en: He has expanded intake units to try and screen new detainees at the jail quickly.
sentences.zh: 他扩大了收押单位，试图快速筛查监狱里的新被拘留者。

sentences.en: And on top of that, the mayor has said that he wanted to hire 600 correction officers.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，市长还表示他想雇佣600名惩教人员。

sentences.en: But that would provide no relief to the department, at least for another several months,
sentences.zh: 但这在未来几个月内不会为该部门提供任何缓解，

sentences.en: because these are officers who have to go through the academy and additional training before they could provide any relief to their colleagues.
sentences.zh: 因为这些警员在能够为同事提供任何帮助之前，必须先通过学院培训和额外训练。

sentences.en: — Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: — And so at least some of these solutions are going to take a while to implement.
sentences.zh: 所以至少其中一些解决方案需要一段时间才能实施。

sentences.en: — So I feel like the obvious question is, what happens to the people who continue to be sent to Rikers in the meantime?
sentences.zh: 我觉得一个显而易见的问题是，在此期间继续被送往赖克斯岛的人会怎样？

sentences.en: — So for people who are already on the island, you know, it means that they're going to have to try to survive to some extent on their own.
sentences.zh: 对于已经在岛上的人来说，这意味着他们必须在某种程度上尝试自救。

sentences.en: — I mean, particularly in units like what Richard Brown described, where there are no officers, the detainees are going to have to still protect themselves.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，特别是在像理查德·布朗描述的那种没有警员的监区，被拘留者仍然必须保护自己。

sentences.en: — I got to know, Jan, what ended up happening to Richard?
sentences.zh: 我得知道，简，理查德最后怎么样了？

sentences.en: — How did you end up getting out of Rikers?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么从赖克斯岛出来的？

sentences.en: How did that happen?
sentences.zh: 那是怎么发生的？

sentences.en: — Yeah, the probation came on the last because they didn't let me out until 28.
sentences.zh: 是的，缓刑是最后才来的，因为他们直到28号才放我出来。

sentences.en: — So Richard, after spending two weeks at Rikers, was released at the end of last month.
sentences.zh: 所以理查德在赖克斯岛待了两周后，于上月底获释。

sentences.en: He was sent to a facility in Connecticut where the probation violation originated.
sentences.zh: 他被送往康涅狄格州的一个设施，那是他违反缓刑规定的源头。

sentences.en: — And what was the facility like in Connecticut?
sentences.zh: 康涅狄格州的那个设施怎么样？

sentences.en: Was it anything like Rikers?
sentences.zh: 它和赖克斯岛有什么相似之处吗？

sentences.en: — No, compared to, excuse my friend, it was like sugar to shit.
sentences.zh: 不，相比之下，请原谅我的粗鲁，那简直是天壤之别。

sentences.en: — He described it being essentially night and day.
sentences.zh: 他形容那里的情况简直是天差地别。

sentences.en: — It was a beautiful experience.
sentences.zh: 那是一次美好的经历。

sentences.en: The guards got control.
sentences.zh: 警卫掌握着控制权。

sentences.en: You were never here.
sentences.zh: 你从来没去过那里。

sentences.en: — He said that there were correction officers there to intervene when needed or to assist when needed.
sentences.zh: 他说那里有惩教人员在需要时进行干预或提供协助。

sentences.en: It was just completely unlike his experience in his very short time at Rikers.
sentences.zh: 这与他在赖克斯岛那段短暂时间的经历完全不同。

sentences.en: — In your life, had you ever experienced jail conditions like that before?
sentences.zh: 在你的人生中，你以前经历过那样的监狱条件吗？

sentences.en: — You know, even as someone who has been incarcerated before, Richard said nothing compares to what he went through at Rikers.
sentences.zh: 你知道，即使作为一个曾经入狱的人，理查德说没有什么能比得上他在赖克斯岛经历的一切。

sentences.en: — It's inhumane.
sentences.zh: 这太不人道了。

sentences.en: It's been that I should ever.
sentences.zh: 我不应该经历这些。

sentences.en: No human should ever go through that.
sentences.zh: 没有人应该经历这些。

sentences.en: No crime is worth that.
sentences.zh: 任何罪行都不值得遭受那样的对待。

sentences.en: — Thank you, Jan.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，简。

sentences.en: — Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: — On Wednesday, in an acknowledgment of how troubled Rikers has become, New York officials ordered that hundreds of detainees be transferred out of the jail.
sentences.zh: 周三，为了承认赖克斯岛已变得多么混乱，纽约官员下令将数百名被拘留者从该监狱转移出去。

sentences.en: The officials said that two groups would be transferred, women and transgender detainees.
sentences.zh: 官员们表示，将转移两类人：女性和跨性别被拘留者。

sentences.en: — New York's governor, Kathy Hochul, said the decision would make Rikers safer, quote,
sentences.zh: 纽约州州长凯西·霍楚尔表示，这一决定将使赖克斯岛更安全，引述如下：

sentences.en: — We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: — Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: — On Wednesday, federal researchers said that people who received Johnson & Johnson's COVID-19 vaccine may be better off with a booster shot from Moderna or Pfizer-BioNTech.
sentences.zh: 周三，联邦研究人员表示，接种了强生新冠疫苗的人，如果补打一针莫德纳或辉瑞-BioNTech的加强针，效果可能会更好。

sentences.en: A small clinical trial has found that those who got J&J's shot, followed by a Moderna booster,
sentences.zh: 一项小型临床试验发现，那些接种了强生疫苗随后补打莫德纳加强针的人，

sentences.en: saw antibody levels rise 76-fold, and those who got a Pfizer-BioNTech booster saw antibody levels rise 35-fold.
sentences.zh: 抗体水平上升了76倍，而接种辉瑞-BioNTech加强针的人抗体水平上升了35倍。

sentences.en: By contrast, those who got a J&J booster saw antibody levels rise just four-fold.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，接种强生加强针的人，抗体水平仅上升了四倍。

sentences.en: That finding could lead to a heated debate about whether and how to offer booster shots to the 15 million Americans who have received J&J's single-dose vaccine.
sentences.zh: 这一发现可能会引发一场激烈的辩论，即是否以及如何为已接种强生单剂疫苗的1500万美国人提供加强针。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Daniel Guimet and Caitlin Roberts, with help from Soraya Shockley, Michael Simon-Johnson, and Jessica Chung.

sentences.en: It was edited by Anita Bonajo, contains original music by Dan Powell and Aliciava Itou, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 节目由安妮塔·博纳乔剪辑，包含丹·鲍威尔和艾丽西亚瓦·伊图的原创音乐，并由克里斯·伍德负责工程制作。

sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly乐队的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹伯格创作。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们将为您准备节日期间的待客之道。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人们宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝到断片才睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这可是非常具体的事情。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢的任何播客平台收听《Wirecutter秀》。

sentences.en: Tune in for your 2018.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，迎接您的2018年。

sentences.en: Thank you for that.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: Let's see you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们明天见。
